name: uniloop-monorepo
description: UniLoop — Smart, Secure, Second-Hand Campus Exchange

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.check: npm run check:server && npm run check:client
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
